found.title: When does aleph_1-categoricity imply omega-stability?
found.note: Baldwin, Laskowski, Shelah; published in Model Theory 3 (2024); shows a sufficient condition (model of size beth_1+) for omega-stability under aleph_1-categoricity of an atomic class, not a resolution of the stated conjecture.

found.title: An analogue of U-rank for atomic classes
found.note: Develops a rank invariant for atomic classes; related structural work, not a resolution of the categoricity transfer question.
